> [!CAUTION]
> **STOP! DO NOT SUBMIT SENSITIVE SECURITY DETAILS IN PUBLIC ISSUES.**
>
> If you have discovered a security vulnerability, side-channel leak, tag forgery flaw, or cryptographic weakness in KDR-CA-AEAD, please follow our private disclosure policy.

### Confidential Reporting Steps

1. Do **NOT** submit this issue form.
2. Email full technical details, proof-of-concept scripts, and impact assessments directly to:
   - Primary Maintainer: **Ashwitha** (`shettyashwitha26@gmail.com`)
   - Project Lead: **Chintan Shetty** (`chntnshetty@gmail.com`)
3. We will acknowledge your report within **48 hours** and provide regular patch status updates.

Refer to our complete [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) policy for full details regarding our 90-day embargo policy and CVE publication timeline.
